details.description: gpt-oss-120b is OpenAI's 120-billion-parameter open-weight language model, released August 5, 2025 under the Apache 2.0 license. It uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with about 117 billion total parameters and roughly 5.1 billion active parameters per token, letting it run on a single 80GB GPU. It supports three configurable reasoning-effort levels (low, medium, high), full chain-of-thought access, and native agentic tool use including function calling, web browsing, Python code execution, and structured outputs, within a 128K-token context window. OpenAI positions it for production, general-purpose, high-reasoning use cases.
advantages: Scores 80.8% on GPQA Diamond (OpenAI gpt-oss-120b model card).
Scores 52.6% on SWE-bench Verified at medium reasoning effort (OpenAI gpt-oss-120b model card).
Runs on a single 80GB GPU despite 117B total parameters, using only about 5.1B active parameters per token (OpenAI gpt-oss-120b model card).
Supports full chain-of-thought access and native tool use for agentic tasks such as web browsing and Python code execution (OpenAI gpt-oss-120b model card).
Released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license with no copyleft restrictions (OpenAI gpt-oss-120b model card / GitHub repo).
disadvantages: Text-only: no image or audio input or output support.
use_cases: Agentic tool-use workflows (browsing, function calling, code execution)
